mapper.sql: id, request_id, job_type, knowledge_id, document_id, document_version_id, target_index_version, idempotency_key, status, list_hidden, progress, attempt_count, max_attempts, last_sequence, lease_owner, lease_expire_time, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, attempt_id, generation_id, last_result_hash, index_snapshot, document_processing_snapshot, rerank_snapshot, parent_job_id, task_payload, budget_account_id, budget_reserved_tokens, execution_budget_tokens, budget_status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_parse_job WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_parse_job SET attempt_id = #{job.attemptId}, generation_id = #{job.generationId}, attempt_count = #{job.attemptCount}, status = #{job.status}, progress = 0, last_sequence = 0, last_result_hash = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expire_time = #{deadline}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, index_snapshot = #{job.indexSnapshot}, document_processing_snapshot = #{job.documentProcessingSnapshot}, rerank_snapshot = NULL, task_payload = #{job.taskPayload}, budget_account_id = #{job.budgetAccountId}, budget_reserved_tokens = #{job.budgetReservedTokens}, execution_budget_tokens = #{job.executionBudgetTokens}, budget_status = #{job.budgetStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{job.id}
UPDATE knowledge_parse_job SET status = 'QUEUED', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE knowledge_parse_job SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = 'KAFKA_DELIVERY_FAILED', error_message = '消息投递失败，请恢复 Kafka 后重试', finished_at = NOW(), lease_expire_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')

UPDATE knowledge_parse_job SET status = #{status}, progress = GREATEST(progress, #{progress}), last_sequence = #{sequence}, last_result_hash = #{hash}, lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_expire_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND) ELSE NULL END, started_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') THEN COALESCE(started_at, NOW()) ELSE started_at END, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'SUCCEEDED') THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND last_sequence < #{sequence} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
mapper.select: SELECT /* knowledge_periodic_scan */ id FROM knowledge_parse_job WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'QUEUED', 'PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_expire_time < NOW() ORDER BY lease_expire_time, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_parse_job SET status = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', error_code = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', error_message = '已请求停止当前执行批次', lease_expire_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE knowledge_parse_job SET status = 'CANCELLED', progress = 0, last_sequence = #{sequence}, last_result_hash = #{hash}, lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_expire_time = NULL, error_code = 'CANCELLED', error_message = '解析任务已取消', finished_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
UPDATE knowledge_parse_job SET budget_status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND budget_status = #{expected}

UPDATE knowledge_parse_job p SET p.progress = COALESCE((SELECT FLOOR(AVG(c.progress)) FROM knowledge_parse_job c WHERE c.parent_job_id = p.id), 100), p.status = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_parse_job c WHERE c.parent_job_id = p.id AND c.status IN ('PENDING','QUEUED','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','CANCEL_REQUESTED')) THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_parse_job c WHERE c.parent_job_id = p.id AND c.status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED')) THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'SUCCEEDED' END, p.error_code = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_parse_job c WHERE c.parent_job_id = p.id AND c.status IN ('PENDING','QUEUED','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','CANCEL_REQUESTED')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_parse_job c WHERE c.parent_job_id = p.id AND c.status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED')) THEN 'REBUILD_CHILD_FAILED' ELSE NULL END, p.error_message = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_parse_job c WHERE c.parent_job_id = p.id AND c.status IN ('PENDING','QUEUED','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','CANCEL_REQUESTED')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_parse_job c WHERE c.parent_job_id = p.id AND c.status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED')) THEN '部分文档索引重建失败' ELSE NULL END, p.finished_at = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_parse_job c WHERE c.parent_job_id = p.id AND c.status IN ('PENDING','QUEUED','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','CANCEL_REQUESTED')) THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END, p.update_time = NOW() WHERE p.id = #{parentJobId} AND p.job_type = 'REBUILD'

UPDATE knowledge_document_version v SET parse_status = #{status}, parse_error_code = #{errorCode}, parse_error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE v.id = #{versionId} AND v.document_id = #{documentId} AND v.parse_status != 'DELETED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document d WHERE d.current_version_id = v.id)
UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{documentId} AND current_version_id IS NULL AND status != 'DELETED'
